objective: Certificar la frescura y ejecucion automatica del sync Comercial V2 para las cinco unidades activas. Solo lectura sobre EDARSAHUB SQL.

queries.name: latest_comercial_v2_sync_by_unit
queries.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    u.codigo AS unidad_codigo,
    UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.system_type,''), NULLIF(s.system_type,''), 'UNKNOWN')) AS system_type,
    l.run_id,
    l.run_type,
    l.fecha_inicio,
    l.fecha_fin,
    l.status,
    l.records_processed,
    l.records_inserted,
    l.records_updated,
    l.records_skipped,
    l.records_errored,
    l.source_connection_status,
    l.error_message,
    l.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY u.codigo
      ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM dbo.Unidades_Negocio u
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Sistema_VW_Servidores_Conexiones_Publico s
    ON CONVERT(varchar(36),s.id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),u.server_id)
  LEFT JOIN dbo.Comercial_SyncLog_v2 l
    ON CONVERT(varchar(36),l.unidad_negocio_id)=CONVERT(varchar(36),u.id)
  WHERE ISNULL(u.activo,0)=1
    AND u.codigo IN ('130QRO','ORIGEN','130MID','CIENFUEGOS','ESTELAR')
)
SELECT
  unidad_codigo,
  system_type,
  run_id,
  run_type,
  fecha_inicio,
  fecha_fin,
  status,
  source_connection_status,
  records_processed,
  records_inserted,
  records_updated,
  records_skipped,
  records_errored,
  error_message,
  created_at,
  DATEDIFF(MINUTE, created_at, SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS minutos_desde_ultima_ejecucion
FROM ranked
WHERE rn=1
ORDER BY system_type, unidad_codigo
